column3: ...This is something that occurred during work.
It's nothing. I just thought of something I had to do.
Is that so? In that case, how about we stop here for today?
No, it'll be done quick. Please continue with your work.
Eh, is that okay with you?
Why? Isn't it very inefficient if you're just waiting here?
No, but... won't it be terrible if I were to make a mistake while you're not around...
As of right now, you're indeed not worthy to be called a capable assistant...
You're not here just to make mistakes, right?
If that's the case, then do your work with confidence. That's all I can say.
I'm counting on you for the time being.
This is a pretty heavy responsibility...
